notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-10-08) for the reorganization of BlackRock MuniYield New Jersey Fund (MYJ) into BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund (MUJ), both closed-end municipal funds. Common shares are exchanged NAV-for-NAV (cash in lieu of fractional shares); MYJ VRDP preferred shares are also exchanged one-for-one for newly issued MUJ VRDP Shares, so the event acts on preferred as well as common (security_class given as common, the class this prospectus registers). exchange_ratio left null because no fixed common-share ratio is stated (the 1:1 is for VRDP preferred only). This preliminary filing leaves the meeting date, record date and expected closing quarter/year blank ('[●] quarter of [●]'), so those fields are null. The Form of Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (Appendix A) is '[TO COME]', so no outside termination date is stated. conditions 'other' covers third-party consents (including the VRDP liquidity provider), an opinion of counsel on corporate and securities matters, and continuing accuracy of representations and warranties. One of the stated listing sentences names the acquirer as 'BlackRock MuniHoldings Quality Fund, Inc.' (sic, no 'New Jersey'); the cover name is used.
